For any set $S,$ we have $\left|\mathcal{P}(S)\right| = 2^{\left| S \right|}.$ Also, $|S \times T| = |S| \cdot |T|.$

In our case, 

$$
\left| Y \right| = 1, \qquad
\left| Z \right| = 2.
$$

As a result, 

$$
\begin{aligned}|P(Y\times Z)| & ={2}^{|Y\times Z|} \\  & ={2}^{|Y|\,\cdot \,|Z|} \\  & ={2}^{1\cdot 2} \\  & ={2}^{2} \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}|P(P(Y\times Z))| & ={2}^{|P(Y\times Z)|} \\  & ={2}^{4} \\  & =16.\end{aligned}
$$
